notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list the Southern Ute Pow-Wow & Fair / Southern Ute event in Ignacio, J.D. Brunson, 970-759-5794, with a call-back instruction. Current Southern Ute Tribe information confirms the Annual Southern Ute Tribal Fair and Powwow in Ignacio. Source: handwritten call notes, pages 117/69; current Southern Ute Tribe website.
